experiment.purpose: Compare GameWorld and GameGen-Verifier on one frozen Number Line Jumper revision using a common evidence contract.

gameworld.role: exploratory gameplay, behavioral discovery, and replay evidence

gamegen-verifier.role: bounded state-grounded verification and before/after evidence
